newsitem.title: USA: U.S. News & World Report names Evans president.
newsitem.headline: U.S. News & World Report names Evans president.

text.p: - U.S. News & World Report Thursday said Tom Evans was named president and publisher.

In his new role, Evans will be responsible for the day-to-day business operations at U.S. News while Fred Drasner, who was president and chief executive officer, will remain chief executive and retain control over the magazine's overall strategic business direction.
Evans, was most recently executive vice president and publisher of U.S. News, a position he has held since 1992.
In addition, Eric Gertler was named executive vice president at the magazine. U.S. News is one of several media properties controlled by Mortimer Zuckerman and Fred Drasner.

Gertler, who will report to Evans, will directly oversee a number of U.S. News departments including finance, manufacturing, distribution, circulation, new media, legal and product extensions. He was most recently president of new media for the various media properties controlled by Zuckerman and Drasner.
